title: Internal: Freezing and Unfreezing a Debit Card
summary: This document provides the internal procedure to temporarily FREEZE or UNFREEZE a debit card. It distinguishes FREEZE (reversible) from CLOSE (irreversible), lists verification/status requirements, steps using freeze_debit_card_3892 and unfreeze_debit_card_3893, and notes effects on transactions/subscriptions, ATM access, and a 90-day unfrozen reminder.
faqs: What’s the difference between freezing a debit card and closing/deactivating it permanently?
When should I freeze a debit card for lost, stolen, or misplaced cards (and why not close immediately)?
What are the requirements before I can freeze a debit card (verification, ownership, and ACTIVE status)?
What should I tell the customer about what happens to new transactions, subscriptions, and pending transactions while the card is frozen?
How do I unfreeze a debit card, and what requirements must be met (FROZEN status and OPEN linked checking account)?
Does freezing affect ATM access, and is there a separate 'ATM Block' step for ATM freeze?
What happens if a frozen card isn’t unfrozen within 90 days? (Reminder notification)
